blocks.text: Buying a Home in Popkum, Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: Popkum

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Highway 1 Exit 135 (Highway 9 / Agassiz-Rosedale Bridge exit), Yale Road East, Bridal Falls Road, and Popkum Road North/South. Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Popkum will find newer freehold single-family subdivisions on standard and large lots, gated resort and cottage communities, rural acreages, and detached view homes beneath Mount Cheam. For a full breakdown of official community plans, catchment maps, and hazard overlays, read our
Popkum Neighbourhood Guide

Families looking at homes for sale in Popkum are served by Rosedale Traditional Community School (K–8 at 50850 Yale Road) and Chilliwack Secondary or Agassiz Elementary-Secondary (confirm exact catchment with SD33 / SD78). Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park (107 hectares of boardwalks, birdwatching trails, and lake views), Bridal Veil Falls Provincial Park, and Elk/Thurston mountain trailheads nearby. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 71 Agassiz–Harrison (connecting Popkum and Bridal Falls to Rosedale, Downtown Chilliwack, Agassiz, and Harrison Hot Springs).

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Popkum

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Popkum are regulated by the Fraser Valley Regional District (FVRD) Official Community Plan for Electoral Area D (Popkum–Bridal Falls Bylaw No. 1366), FVRD community water/sewer vs. private septic servicing, and alluvial fan hazard guidelines. Which schools serve Popkum in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Popkum include Rosedale Traditional Community School (K–8 at 50850 Yale Road) and Chilliwack Secondary or Agassiz Elementary-Secondary (confirm exact catchment with SD33 / SD78). Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Popkum?

Residents of Popkum have access to Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park (107 hectares of boardwalks, birdwatching trails, and lake views), Bridal Veil Falls Provincial Park, and Elk/Thurston mountain trailheads nearby. See our
Popkum Neighbourhood Guide

How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Popkum?

Key road corridors serving Popkum include Highway 1 Exit 135 (Highway 9 / Agassiz-Rosedale Bridge exit), Yale Road East, Bridal Falls Road, and Popkum Road North/South. Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 71 Agassiz–Harrison (connecting Popkum and Bridal Falls to Rosedale, Downtown Chilliwack, Agassiz, and Harrison Hot Springs).
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Popkum?

Properties in Popkum are governed by the Fraser Valley Regional District (FVRD) Official Community Plan for Electoral Area D (Popkum–Bridal Falls Bylaw No. 1366), FVRD community water/sewer vs. private septic servicing, and alluvial fan hazard guidelines. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Popkum freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Popkum are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
